subject: Re: Quick sync: trial-demo orchestration & IT checklist for StratusHealth
messages:
From: Samir Ali <samir.ali@stratushealth.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-01 09:12 EDT
Subject: Trial access & short demo request

Hi Monica,

We just spun up a trial via your self-serve flow and I was hoping to get a short walkthrough this week. I'm the lead for integrations at StratusHealth — want to make sure our IT/security folks are comfortable before we scope a pilot.

Three quick asks:
- 20–30 minute session focused on data flow and auth (SAML/KMS)
- Can an SE join to field technical questions?
- Any prep docs we should share with our security team in advance?

Thanks — my availability (ET): Thu 7/2 10–12 or Fri 7/3 14–16.

Cheers,
Samir
Lead, Integrations
StratusHealth
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Ali <samir.ali@stratushealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-01 10:05 EDT
Subject: Re: Trial access & short demo request

Hey Samir — congrats on getting started with the trial!

I work on SDR -> AE handoffs; looping in Monica (AE) and Connor (SE) from our side so we can lock a slot and cover both product + security. Monica — Samir prefers Thu 10–12ET or Fri 14–16ET. Priya from their IT might want to join (Samir copied her on the intro).

Can you and Connor confirm if 30 minutes is enough or whether we should plan 45? Also, I can send a Calendly link but happy to coordinate via your availability.

Thanks,
Karthik
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Ali <samir.ali@stratushealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01 13:22 EDT
Subject: Re: Trial access & short demo request

Samir — great to meet you (virtually). 30 minutes should be fine to cover architecture, auth, and next steps, but if Priya wants to dig into compliance artifacts we can add a follow-up dedicated to that. Connor will handle the technical deep-dive.

Proposed slots (ET) — pick one:
- Thu 7/2 10:30–11:00 ET (30m)
- Thu 7/2 11:30–12:00 ET (30m)
- Fri 7/3 14:00–14:45 ET (45m) — slightly longer if you want a mini-POC plan

I'll tentatively hold Thu 10:30 ET for 15 minutes while we confirm. Agenda: 1) 10 min overview + trial tips, 2) 15 min auth/KMS/SAML config + Q&A, 3) 5 min next steps (pilot scope).

Attaching a short demo guide and an IT checklist for Priya.

— Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-guide.pdf (pdf), stratus-it-checklist.docx (docx)
From: Priya Desai <p.desai@stratushealth.com>
To: Samir Ali <samir.ali@stratushealth.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Tina Morales <tina.morales@stratushealth.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-02 08:03 EDT
Subject: Re: Quick sync: trial-demo orchestration & IT checklist for StratusHealth

Thanks for the invite. A couple items from our security team before we lock:
- Do you have a SOC 2 report we can review?
- Clarify whether the trial stores any PHI on Redwood-managed systems (we expect none, but need written confirmation)
- Can you share the exact endpoints and any IP ranges for allowlisting?

Also, our team is in EST; Thu 7/2 10:30 ET works for us but please include a calendar invite with the dial-in and timezone explicitness. If the session will cover tenant-level config, Connor should have a shareable runbook.

— Priya
IT Security, StratusHealth
Attachments referenced: stratus-it-checklist.docx (they added comments)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <p.desai@stratushealth.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Ali <samir.ali@stratushealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-02 11:10 EDT
Subject: Re: Quick sync: trial-demo orchestration & IT checklist for StratusHealth

Hi Priya — thanks for the checklist. Quick answers:
- SOC 2 Type II: happy to share the redacted report during the meeting; I'll send the document link after the call and we can share a signed NDA if you need the full version.
- Trial storage: default trial tenants do not accept PHI by policy; I'll confirm the tenant settings we provisioned for your account and include a short note in the runbook.
- IP ranges: see the public allowlist here -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-demo-brief (I'll pin the ip_allowlist.txt in that folder).

I'll join Thu 7/2 10:30 ET and will have a short runbook ready to screen-share. If you prefer 45 minutes we can take Fri 7/3 14:00 ET.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Ali <samir.ali@stratushealth.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@stratushealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-07-03 16:45 EDT
Subject: Confirmed: Thu 7/2 10:30 ET — Redwood trial walkthrough (30m)

Thanks everyone — confirming Thu 7/2 10:30–11:00 ET (30 minutes). Calendar invite sent (explicit ET timezone).

Quick agenda (final):
- 10:30–10:40: Monica — product overview + trial navigation tips
- 10:40–10:55: Connor — auth/KMS/SAML config + allowlist review
- 10:55–11:00: Next steps & pilot scoping (ownership + deliverables)

Pre-reads: redwood-demo-guide.pdf (attached), Connor's runbook link in the shared Drive.

Samir/Priya — please reply if Tina or anyone else needs to be added to the invite. Otherwise we'll plan to give the team the SOC 2 excerpt and IP allowlist during the session and follow up with the redacted report if you sign the NDA.

See you on Thu — Monica
